column5: prompt   (start/end are gen/keys/<name>.png; a trailing ! mirrors that pose)
gallops at full speed to the right, running in place on a treadmill, legs reaching and pushing in a fast gallop cycle, ears flapping, tongue out.
sits calmly and contentedly, breathing gently, blinks slowly, tail sweeps a little on the floor, small relaxed head movements.
sits facing the viewer and looks at the viewer, tilts her head curiously to one side and back, blinks, ears twitch.
sits facing the viewer, overjoyed, tongue out panting, tail wagging fast, wiggling happily.
sniffs the ground with her nose down, nose moving around searching, tail wagging slowly.
sits and lifts her back leg to scratch behind her ear rapidly, head tilted, eyes half closed.
is fast asleep curled up in a ball, slow deep breathing, body gently rising and falling, eyes closed, otherwise completely still.
is fast asleep on her back with her belly up, paws in the air twitching gently as she dreams, slow breathing.
lies on the floor resting with her head up, breathing slowly, blinks, ears twitch, tail thumps gently.
is being held up in the air, legs dangling and paddling gently, ears swaying, looking sheepish.
is falling down through the air, legs spread out, ears flapping upwards, surprised.
lies down on the floor, turns around once and curls up into a ball to go to sleep.
wakes up, lifts her head, uncurls and stands up, then gives a little shake.
does a big play bow stretch: front legs reach forward, chest goes down to the floor, bottom up in the air, then she stands back up.
turns around on the spot to face the other way, turning her body towards the viewer as she turns.
crouches down and springs up into the air in a big leap.
